description:
Diagnose and fix a runtime application hang (infinite loop) in the 'RayPlan' radiation treatment planning system.

The system hangs when processing 'Patient_003' in the nightly batch job. Your task is to:
1. Import the 'RayPlan' Maven project from ~/eclipse-workspace/RayPlan/ into Eclipse.
2. Run the 'BatchProcessor' class to confirm the hang.
3. Use the Debugger to identify the infinite loop in 'GradientDescentOptimizer.java'.
4. Fix the code by adding a maximum iteration limit (e.g., 10000 iterations) or a stagnation check to break the loop if convergence fails.
5. Run the application again to ensure it completes and generates the output report at ~/Desktop/dose_report.csv.
